item.title: Hacker, Hipster, Hustler - which are you?
item.description:
There’s a role for everyone at RGUHack

The Hacker

Do you love working with new tools and frameworks? Wanting to code right away? You will be responsible for turning dreams and wireframes into apps and websites, no matter how many bugs you encounter, making sure that the team vision is materialised and (hopefully) running.

The Hipster

Happen to find yourself looking at the resolution of a logo or figuring out the font of a cafe menu for too long? You will make sure that whatever the team makes looks, feels and sounds as awesome as possible with your artistic touch. Give that much-needed WOW factor to it all.

item.title: The Ultimate Hack List: Must-Have Items at RGUHack
item.description:
Packing for a hackathon can be a confusing ordeal, especially if it is your first one. Do you bring a change of outfit? A game to play for chill time? Snacks to get you through it? It can be an overwhelming experience. Not sure where to start? Don’t worry, we have you covered. Check out the list below for must-have items people always forget to improve your hack experience!

Basic Hygiene Items

Toothbrush/toothpaste, deodorant, painkillers and lots of water!

Every morning of an RGU Hackathon there is a scamble (even within the committee!) to find the legendary few that remembered to bring deodorant and toothpaste.
When you pitch your ideas at the end of the event you want to feel clean and refreshed, and these items go a long way in boosting your confidence.
Headaches and pains are often common, so please also remember a water bottle and some painkillers (and to occasionally look away from your screens) to help prevent yourself from feeling unwell.

item.title: Getting Here
item.description:
RGUHack is held in the Sir Ian Wood Building on the RGU Garthdee Campus in Aberdeen

The Sir Ian Wood Building, Robert Gordon University, Garthdee Rd, Aberdeen AB10 7GJ

Getting to the campus is easy, either using the No. 1 or 2 Bus routes from Union St. which is a 5-10 min walk from Aberdeen train and bus station.

What do I need to bring?

Our Comms & Engagement Lead, Abigail, has put together a list of essentials for the hack. Check it out here.
